goal.description: Goal is the desired result. When empty, Sprint or Issue supplies it.

plan.description: Plan is an optional absolute local file containing the plan/specification.

acceptance.description: Acceptance states the observable acceptance requirements.

constraints.description: Constraints carries non-negotiable constraints for every role.

context_files.description: ContextFiles are local files whose contents are supplied as scoped context.

checks.description: Checks are explicit repository commands. When present they replace default Gimble checks.

supervisor_interval_seconds.description: SupervisorIntervalSeconds controls task supervisor look frequency. Zero uses the runtime default.

finish.description: Finish controls the exit policy: local (default), pr, or merge.

sprint.description: The sprint to build: its number in ephemeral/research/api/SPRINTS.md, e.g. 2. Zero when an issue is built instead.

issue.description: The issue to build instead of a sprint: a GitHub issue number, or the path of a file holding the issue's text. Empty when a sprint is built.

repo.description: Absolute path of the repository. Each validated task is committed to the branch checked out there, and the sprint ends by merging that branch.

model.description: Codex model for the researcher, the planner, and the coders, e.g. "gpt-5.6-luna".

review_model.description: Claude Code model for the supervisors and the validator, e.g. "haiku".

tasks.description: The most tasks to run in all. The sprint fails if the planner is not done by then.

dry_run.description: Call no model and run no command: print each prompt with the schema it would send, answered with an example value, so every prompt can be read before a real run. A viewer, never proof.
